output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # The diagrams are partitioned by full-width/full-height divider lines of 5.
    # For known-style noisy panels, select the least frequent nonzero entry (ties
    # resolved by scan order); empty panels become 0.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # preserve complete divider lines
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==5 for x in r)]
    cs=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==5 for i in range(h))]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    for a in range(len(rb)-1):
      for b in range(len(cb)-1):
       r0,r1=rb[a]+1,rb[a+1]; c0,c1=cb[b]+1,cb[b+1]
       vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1) if grid[i][j]!=5]
       nz=[x for x in vals if x!=0]
       v=0
       if nz:
        counts={x:nz.count(x) for x in set(nz)}
        v=min(nz,key=lambda x:(counts[x],nz.index(x)))
       for i in range(r0,r1):
        for j in range(c0,c1): out[i][j]=v
    return out"}
